title: Math Mentor learner-bound store metadata
description: Immutable binding between a store and exactly one learner. Validated with the same strictness as events: an arbitrary nonempty YAML field is not a binding. The directory name is never authority.

store_id.description: Opaque store identifier. Deliberately not derived from a learner name.

bound_student_ref.description: Privacy-safe alias, same pattern as an event's student_ref.

bound_epoch.description: Must equal the package's canonical bound epoch; a store may not silently follow a different transition semantics.
